name: Threads (Meta)
one_liner: Meta's Threads API for publishing posts, replies, insights, and search on Threads accounts.
auth_notes: Threads OAuth flow with short-lived tokens exchanged for long-lived tokens (Meta official sample repo). Uses a separate Threads app ID and secret, not the regular Meta app credentials. Redirect URLs cannot be localhost.
access_notes: Free; no price published. Developers use own account/testers in development; users without a role on the app require per-permission Meta App Review (screencast). Review specifics come from third-party blogs only; Meta docs returned HTTP 400 to the fetcher.

buildability.rationale: Free OAuth2 API with publishing, replies, search, insights and quotas; production use for other users needs Meta App Review per permission. Official docs not fetchable, so review details rely on third-party sources.

needs_human_reason: developers.facebook.com/docs/threads pages return HTTP 400 to the fetcher, so app review requirements, webhooks and rate limits are not confirmed from Meta docs.

auth.quote: Sign in through the Threads oAuth flow and exchange short-lived tokens for long-lived tokens.
Make sure that you are using the APP ID and Secret defined for the Threads API of your app.

api_surface.quote: Quotas: View API usage for publishing, replies, deletion, and location search.
Search by keyword or topic tag with Top or Recent results.

identity.quote: You can use this Sample App to test the Threads API.
